I have just migrated lots of my repos from #Gitlab to self-hosted #Forgejo. Forgejo has great documentation and many config options, but configuration is tiring via CLI.

So, I made this Forgejo Configurator - runs locally in your browser and allows you to configure Forgejo app.ini via friendly #UI:
https://ambience.sk/tools/forgejo-configurator.html

Please, test and enjoy.
